### Demostración Formal en Lean 4 (Sub-Landauer Dissipation Bound in Golden Ratio Base):

```lean
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.SetIntegral

theorem sub_landauer_bound (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (kB : ℝ) (hkB : kB > 0) (phi : ℝ) (hphi : phi = (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2) :
  kB * T * Real.log phi < kB * T * Real.log 2 := by
  have h1 : phi < 2 := by
    rw [hphi]
    have h_sqrt5 : Real.sqrt 5 < 3 := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_lt']
      norm_num
    linarith
  have h2 : Real.log phi < Real.log 2 := Real.log_lt_log (by rw [hphi]; norm_num) h1
  exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2 (mul_pos hkB hT)
```
